opened_development_reference.forbidden_variance_contract: balanced fixed-order two-level log variance with nine positive then nine negative coordinates

spatial_generator.balance: exactly half positive and half negative

splits.role: fit posterior/approximation parameters only; no claim, threshold or candidate selection
splits.access_policy: write model fit and training diagnostics; never read pilot or formal

splits.role: freeze posterior calibration, likelihood truncation and finite candidate grid without choosing a winner
splits.access_policy: write frozen calibration maps and finite candidate hashes; never select using pilot/formal outcomes

splits.role: select exactly one candidate and strongest eligible deployable baseline once
splits.access_policy: one deterministic selection pass; lock candidate/baseline/checkpoint/config hashes before formal access

splits.role: untouched confirmatory evaluation; no fit, calibration, threshold change, candidate replacement or denominator change
splits.access_policy: read once after pilot lock and eligibility ledger; append raw shards only

statistics.independent_cluster: seed; resample all methods, distances, sigma strata, families and windows for that seed together
statistics.simultaneous_method: paired cluster percentile with fixed Bonferroni divisor 12 even if fewer methods qualify
statistics.relative_improvement: (baseline_p_L-proposed_p_L)/baseline_p_L; undefined if paired baseline denominator is zero
statistics.tail_windows: nonoverlapping; partial windows retained in raw ledger but excluded from registered tail denominator
statistics.directional_strata: d=3/d=5 and every registered sigma are reported; no stratum may reverse beyond its 95% degradation margin
statistics.multiplicity: method family, four tail endpoints and OOD families are separate preregistered simultaneous families; no post-hoc regrouping

power_plan.test: one-sided normal approximation for paired cluster mean used only for design; final inference is bootstrap
power_plan.power_shortfall_rule: retain fixed N and CI gate; report achieved precision/power sensitivity without extending or replacing formal seeds

missingness.paired_trace_rule: all eligible methods receive the same physical trace hash
missingness.proposed_failure: count remaining registered decisions in the failed cell as logical errors and fail integrity gate
missingness.baseline_failure: retain row as failed/ineligible; do not remove it to make the proposed method strongest; SOTA wording closes if a required eligible baseline is not completed
missingness.corrupt_shard: quarantine whole shard, regenerate only from the same immutable seed/config before any aggregate is read

stopping_rules.partial_results_policy: retain raw shards and failure state; never publish the completed favorable subset as formal

allowed_after_seal: environment/provenance completion with no analysis effect
amendment_policy.analysis_change_rule: invalidate protocol v1 and start a new prospectively registered protocol; v1 outcomes cannot be rescued
